name: zclass_node_clear_pickup_flags_recursive
description: zClass_Node::ClearPickupFlagsRecursive clears pickup-specific flags on a node and every child in its listB tree.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x41ceb0 identifies the recursive listB walk and clear mask 0x40018; the native pickup leaf smoke verifies the root and child flag clearing while preserving unrelated bits.
